comment: Differences that the regression check (diffreport.py --known) does not report as new. An entry with an issue is a known regression that has an open issue; an entry without one is an accepted, intended change. Every key of an entry must match: check (parser, inspections, formatter, exceptions, timing); file (a glob of the corpus path); tool (the inspection id); text (a part of the problem, parse error or exception text); metric (lex, parse, highlight) and maxRatio (timing). Remove an entry when its issue is fixed.

entries.why: defined(Macro) in an -if or -elif condition is marked as an unresolved function (#1130)
highlighting is up to 2.5x slower because of the variable resolve of #1152
